|strategy=By Dave Detlefs, Gold 36<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/specialedition/dark/small/nebit.html</ref>

[[Nebit]] is perhaps the greatest [[Jawa (Dark){{!}}Jawa]] to lead an attack. With a power of 2, he is not to formidable by himself, but how often does one [[Jawa (Dark){{!}}Jawa]] battle by himself? All you need is three more Jawas and you have a total power of 5. Still a little weak. But consider this, You now have a total ability of 4. This allows you to draw a battle destiny. Not bad. Then, [[Nebit]]'s game text allows you to draw an additional battle destiny. Now you have a power of 5 with 2 battle destiny. With an average draw of 3, that's a total power of 11. Not too bad. As an added kick, if you draw a higher total battle destiny than your opponent, you reduce your attrition by 3. This is a great asset. After the battle, no one has to die. Now picture this situation happening at the [[Jawa (Dark){{!}}Jawa]] Canyon or with Witten adding his power bonus. Talk about your [[Jawa (Dark){{!}}Jawa]] Strike Force.

[[Nebit]] + [[Jabba's Twerps]] = Three Jawas for an automatic two destiny when your opponent least expects it. [[Nebit]] is an alien [[Red Leader{{!}}Leader]].
